# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

No private reporting route is currently verified or advertised for this repository.
The owner must verify a private route for the replacement repository before
requesting sensitive reports or advertising GitHub private vulnerability reporting.

Do not open public issues containing vulnerability details, suspected secrets,
or personal data. Do not use pull requests or public comments to disclose them.

## Scope

This repository contains a synthetic static application and standalone engineering
examples. Reports should concern its code and files. The private operational
system, production infrastructure, retailer services, and third-party accounts
are outside this repository's reporting scope.

Local scans and contract tests provide scoped evidence, not proof of complete
security. See the evidence guide for verification boundaries.
